rows.title: Direct-sum conjecture for transversal q-matroids
rows.statement:
Let $M_1$ and $M_2$ be transversal $q$-matroids with presentations $\mathcal{X}_1$ and $\mathcal{X}_2$. Their **direct sum** is denoted by $M_1
ame{oplus}M_2$, and the corresponding combined presentation is denoted by $\mathcal{X}_1
ame{oplus}\mathcal{X}_2$.

**Direct-sum conjecture for transversal q-matroids.** The direct sum $M_1\oplus M_2$ is a transversal $q$-matroid with presentation $\mathcal{X}_1\oplus\mathcal{X}_2$.

The conjecture would extend the established coordinate case to arbitrary transversal $q$-matroids and provide an analogous construction of presentations under direct sums. Its resolution is not supplied in the source.
rows.source_name: Andrew Fulcher, “A cyclic flat embedding theorem for transversal q-matroids”, arXiv:2603.13550 (2026).
rows.references:
**3 papers in this index state this conjecture** (2003–2026). The statement above is taken from the most recent of them; the others are [arXiv:1111.5291](https://arxiv.org/abs/1111.5291), [arXiv:math/0305418](https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0305418).

Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.13550

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of March 2026).

purpose: Independent all-presentation q-transversal directsum proof,fidelity,prior/significance qualification,no formaltools or selfacceptance
